intro: Stormwind’s crown and armies rest with Bolvar Fordragon while King Varian is missing. As Regent and Supreme Commander of Stormwind’s armed forces, he stands beside young King Anduin in Stormwind Keep and tries to hold the kingdom together. Domestic troubles grow, while Lady Katrana Prestor’s counsel often delays his military decisions.

p: King Varian vanished on the way to a peace summit on Theramore Isle, leaving Stormwind in political disarray. Ten-year-old Prince Anduin was crowned to preserve continuity, while Highlord Bolvar Fordragon took up the work of ruling as Regent. A venerated paladin devoted to the crown, Bolvar now faces a kingdom under strain. Stormwind’s soldiers are spread thin across Westfall, Redridge, and Duskwood. Lady Katrana Prestor’s dismissive counsel adds to the burden, repeatedly blocking him from sending royal troops to towns on the frontier.
